name: Ano Toki no Kotoba o Kikitakute...
original_name: あの時のコトバを聞きたくて…
source:
I want to meet him again -- Haru
Play as a transfer student and interact with three boys named “Haru”
Can you find the boy from your youth?


I was made fun of for being chubby,
and I was crying. That's when a boy approached me.
I only remember his name.

I want to meet him -- Haru --
one more time.

Wanting to talk to Haru again,
I hid my past
and decided to seek him out.

[From the [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/in-search-of-haru-sweet-story/id1263397981]App Store[/url]]
translation:
我想再次見到他——春

扮演轉學生，結識三個都叫「春」的男孩。
你能找到童年時遇見的那個男孩嗎？

我因為身材肥胖被人嘲笑，
哭泣時，一個男孩向我走來。
我只記得他的名字。

我想再次見到他——春——
再一次。

為了再次與春交談，
我隱藏過去，
決定尋找他。

[來源：[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/in-search-of-haru-sweet-story/id1263397981]App Store[/url]]
